title: POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy
description:
Travel Caddy for POTV Lobo Dosing Capsules

Take your prepacked sessions on the go with the Planet of the Vapes Dosing Capsule Caddy! This metallic travel caddy holds up to four POTV Lobo dosing capsules with an airtight seal that’s both water-proof and smell-proof. Pack your capsules, load them into the caddy, and then hook it onto a keychain, belt loop, or travel pouch with the included keychain ring.

For the traveling vaporist, this is a must-have accessory for quick, seamless sessions wherever you are.

Secure and discreet

The POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy is a secure and safe way to carry a few dosing capsules wherever you go. Prepack your capsules and fill the caddy with up to four at a time, twist the lid tightly, and then securely hook it onto your belt loop, keychain, or travel pouch.

When ready, simply drop a capsule into the oven and enjoy! When it’s time to reload, easily swap another capsule in without attracting unwanted attention.

Smell-proof and water-proof

Keep your herbs fresh and safe from the elements with our dosing capsule caddy. These caddies are designed with an airtight seal to keep unwanted odors in and water out.

Choose your color!

Add some style to your vaporizer setup with a matching capsule caddy!

POTV Lobo Caddy Colors:

– Black
– Blue
– Green

Compatible with POTV Lobo dosing Capsules ONLY

This capsule caddy is compatible with POTV Lobo dosing capsules ONLY. XMAX V3 Pro Dosing Capsules are smaller than Lobo capsules and will rattle around in this caddy. Tinymight 2 dosing capsules are too large for this Lobo Dosing Capsule Caddy.

Looking for the POTV ONE Capsule Caddy?

Official POTV accessory

This is the official dosing capsule caddy for POTV Lobo dosing capsules – designed, tested, and approved by our team of product experts and engineers.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.

See more of our POTV Parts and Accessories.

POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy FAQs

How do you load the caddy?
Unscrew the top of the POTV Dosing Capsule Caddy and put your dosing capsules in the tube. Then, screw the top back on until it is snug.

How many capsules does the caddy hold?
The POTV Dosing Capsule Caddy holds up to four dosing capsules.

Is the caddy smell-proof?
Yes! The o-ring by the threads keeps smells in and liquids out.

What to avoid
Don’t over-tighten the lid and stress the o-ring. If the o-ring starts to bulge out, loosen the cap a little bit.
